resolutions.change: The estimate is sampled on the frozen grid over the WHOLE map; region membership is applied afterwards and reported (membership.est_outside_region_n/fraction + membership_hash). The nearest reference neighbour is searched in the FULL reference cloud, never in a region-cropped one. Support is classified supported / drifted_out_of_support / no_reference_locally (no reference cell within max(2 voxel, 10 x support_radius)); an unclassifiable fraction above unknown_no_reference_max_frac (0.05) is a decisive unknown. Drifted-out samples stay in the primary metric. CORRECTED 2026-09-30: there is NO '>50% outside the frozen region is a coverage failure' rule in the implementation (that sentence described a test fixture, not the gate). The actual gate on outside-region points is R38 below: zero-tolerance attribution to a MEASURED member set.

A supplied SE(3) needs source + source_artifact or source_artifact_sha256 + independent_of_evaluation=true + a fit_region provably disjoint from the eval_region (box-box intersection test, id-id comparison, unresolvable -> treated as intersecting). Any failure -> NOT_PASSABLE_TRANSFORM_NOT_INDEPENDENT. Rigidity is checked first (scale/shear/reflection rejected).

Time coverage is measured now: coverage_tolerance_s is PRE-DECLARED (default = 0.5 x gt_nominal_period_s; never the estimate's own median interval), the denominator is the FULL evaluation window (= the GT span in the offset-corrected domain; the common-window variant is reported separately), and the coverage is the measure in SECONDS of the union of [t_i - tol, t_i + tol] intersected with that window. The sample ratio is reported as gt_samples_covered_fraction and explicitly labelled 'NOT time coverage'. A tf_consumer_rule block (hold_validity_s / assoc_tolerance_s / gap_limit_s / tf_tolerance_s) is defined in the contract and is BLOCKED when unsupplied.

The declared chain ACTS on the estimate: source_frame/target_frame/sensor_entity/gt_entity must be declared (else BLOCKED_FRAME_CHAIN_UNDECLARED); a frame change requires T_target_source and an entity change requires lever_arm_m (else BLOCKED_MISSING_FRAME_CHAIN). Order: lever arm in the SOURCE frame, then T_target_source. The same comparison without the chain is reported as association.ate_raw_unaligned_m (ated_unaligned_*) and is never an accuracy number.

Coincidence is a 3-D point coincidence: exact_coincidence_c2c_fraction counts samples whose C2C distance to the nearest reference point is <= 1e-6 m. A zero point-to-plane residual is reported separately as zero_plane_residual_fraction with the explicit note that it only means the normal matched. The hard block is > 0.99 (identical sample sets); above 0.05 it raises a decisive self-referential unknown.
evidence: test_map_accuracy_eval.py::test_tangential_offset_is_invisible_to_point_to_plane (0.06 m tangential slip, C2C fraction < 1%, no unknown)

resolutions.change: Warnings and DECISIVE unknowns are separate lists. unknown_states carries {code, detail} and each code either maps to a hard status (UNKNOWN_SUPPORT_CLASSIFICATION -> NOT_MEASURABLE_UNKNOWN_SUPPORT_CLASSIFICATION) or blocks a PASS directly when the global value would have passed (UNKNOWN_REGIONAL_GAP, UNKNOWN_SELF_REFERENTIAL_COMPARISON), with unknown_gate_note recording why. A FAIL is still reported as FAIL (a failure is not an acceptance claim) but the unknowns are listed alongside.
evidence: evaluation/map_accuracy_eval.py: warnings/unknown_states construction and the verdict gate

resolutions.change: The cross-check is split. --mode strict: SAME contract quantity (same fixed denominator, same k/radius neighbourhood, normals queried at the same reference-neighbour positions; only the NN library primitive and the two contract primitives that define the sample set are shared) with INDEPENDENT ARITHMETIC (batched SVD normals, a different residual expression, explicit-loop aggregation) -> agreement verifies the arithmetic. --mode sensitivity: a deliberately different estimand (uniform subsample, k=8, normals at the estimate position), labelled 'NOT a correctness proof', never replacing the main metric. Both report a MEASURED tolerance: 3 x the across-fold standard error of the metric (fold_uncertainty), not a hand-picked 5 mm/10%.

resolutions_added_20260930.defect: the --outside-attribution gate was DECLARATIVE: it checked only {source, source_artifact|source_artifact_sha256, independent_of_estimate:true, independent_of_error:true} and then recorded the WHOLE outside set as attributed. The v1 record shipped with the controlled A/B therefore attributed 100% of the outside points although its own declared member region (reference-map AABB minus ROI AABB) covers only 75.69% of the fork's outside points (9.37% upstream) -- measured member geometry was never consulted.
resolutions_added_20260930.change: map_accuracy_eval.py v2.3.1: the membership of every outside point is MEASURED against the geometry the record itself declares -- member_region/v1 include-box union MINUS exclude-box union (parse_member_region / member_region_mask) -- AND the declared member_region.frame must be present and equal the frame the outside points are actually measured in (the frozen ROI's frame). The same numeric bounds in another frame are a different region and attribute nothing, so a mis-framed or frameless member_region is refused; a declared frame_conversion is also refused (rigid re-boxing of a declared AABB would inflate the region and over-attribute), so any sourced conversion must be applied upstream and the boxes declared already in the evaluation frame. The declarative flags still gate admissibility but attribute nothing by themselves; a record with absent, non-independent or unusable geometry attributes nothing; ANY point the declared geometry does not cover stays an unknown residual (membership.outside_region_attribution.measured.residual_uncovered_n/fraction + residual_is_a_decisive_unknown) and blocks an overall PASS. The measured coverage, the geometry hash, the frame actually checked against and the residual counts are recorded in every result. No tolerance fraction and no bound tuned to the estimate's point count was introduced. A ROI artifact carrying invalid=true is refused (validate_roi).
